contents.notes: Local desktop. p95 latency is retained as an evidence gate and the full host/toolchain/environment identity is recorded for every cell.

manifest.hypothesis: Does bounded factorized typed pair attention improve compositional routing accuracy over an operation- and parameter-matched Off control without calibration degradation?
manifest.metrics: IID/OOD accuracy; NLL; ECE15; coverage; selective error; parameters; FLOPs; p95 latency
manifest.baseline: the identical FactorizedV2 architecture with the computed pair bias multiplied by zero
manifest.falsification: Any missing gate, OOD accuracy below the bound, fold sign reversal, NLL/ECE regression, IID harm, inadequate coverage, selective-error harm or compute mismatch yields INCONCLUSIVE/NO-GO.
